metadata.title: Monochromatic Portrait with Signature and Text

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic, high-contrast portrait of a man, cropped from the chest up, looking to the right. The background is dark and textured. A stylized signature and small text elements are placed in the lower right corner, with a parental advisory label in the lower left.
coreVisualRelationships: The portrait dominates the composition, creating a strong focal point.
The dark background provides a stark contrast, emphasizing the subject's features.
The signature and text elements are secondary, positioned to not distract from the main portrait.
The overall monochromatic scheme unifies all elements, creating a cohesive and serious mood.
coreInvariants: Portrait of a man, cropped from chest up, looking right.
Signature-like graphic element in the lower right.
Small text elements in the lower right.
Parental advisory label in the lower left.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's head and upper torso occupy approximately 70% of the vertical space and are centered horizontally, slightly shifted to the left to accommodate the gaze direction.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and mouth, serve as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye is drawn first to the subject's face, then follows the gaze to the right, and finally descends to the text and signature elements in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space surrounds the subject, particularly on the right and top, enhancing the focus on the portrait and providing room for the text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark gray/black serves as the dominant background and shadow color, creating a somber and serious mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light gray/white highlights on the subject's skin and hair provide strong contrast, defining form and drawing attention to facial features.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: None, the image is strictly monochromatic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The image features a full range of values from deep black to bright white, with no saturation, creating a high-contrast grayscale aesthetic.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The text 'SCORPION 2018' uses a sans-serif typeface with consistent stroke width and slightly condensed letterforms. The parental advisory label uses a compact, bold sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: All letters are uppercase for 'SCORPION' and 'ADVISORY'.
Numerals for '2018' match the style of 'SCORPION'.
The parental advisory text is tightly packed within a rectangular outline.

composition.position: lower right, overlapping the subject's shoulder
composition.scale: large, dominant within its text block
composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the lower right, appearing as a personal mark

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: single line for 'SCORPION', single line for '2018'

composition.position: below and to the right of the signature
composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the lower right corner, distinct from the portrait

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: multiple lines within a small box

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a small rectangular graphic, distinct from the portrait

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A script-like signature is paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for informational text, creating a contrast between personal touch and clear communication. The parental advisory uses a distinct, compact sans-serif for official labeling.
graphicDevices: A rectangular outline for the parental advisory label.

preserve: The contrast between the flowing signature and the structured sans-serif text.
The all-caps setting for 'SCORPION' and the parental advisory text.
The small scale and placement of the informational text.
The compact, bold nature of the parental advisory text within its box.
avoid: Script fonts for 'SCORPION' or the parental advisory.
Decorative or highly stylized fonts for the informational text.

candidateDirections.reason: To replicate the personal, handwritten feel of the large signature.
For the clean, modern, and legible 'SCORPION 2018' text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Compact, bold sans-serif (e.g., Impact, Anton, Bebas Neue)
candidateDirections.reason: For the parental advisory label, emphasizing its official and warning nature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, high-contrast portrait of a man, cropped from the chest up, looking to the right. Ensure a dark, textured background. The subject should have defined facial features and hair waves. Leave the lower left and lower right corners clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a light gray, stylized, flowing signature in the lower right, partially overlapping the subject's shoulder. Below and to the right of the signature, add 'SCORPION' in light gray, all caps, sans-serif, followed by '2018' in the same style on a new line. In the lower left corner, add a small black rectangular box with a white outline, containing the 'PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT' text in white, bold, condensed, all-caps sans-serif, centered and tightly packed.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait monochromatic and high-contrast?
Is the signature clearly distinct from the sans-serif text?
Is the parental advisory label small, compact, and in the lower left?
Are all text elements light gray or white against the dark background/box?
Does the overall composition maintain a serious and focused mood?

adjustableVariables: Specific texture of the background (subtle variations)
Exact placement of the signature and text (within the general lower right area)
Weight and width of the sans-serif fonts (within the specified categories)
mustRedesign: Any use of color beyond grayscale.
Changing the subject's pose or gaze direction significantly.
Placing text elements in the upper half of the image.
Using highly decorative or serif fonts.

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of all text elements.
A sense of depth and texture in the portrait and background.

postGenerationChecks: Verify the monochromatic nature of the entire image.
Confirm the subject's gaze direction and cropping.
Check the legibility and placement of all text elements (signature, 'SCORPION 2018', parental advisory).
Ensure the background texture is present and not distracting.
Confirm the overall mood is serious and contemplative.
Check for any unintended color artifacts or gradients.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate a high-contrast, monochromatic portrait of a subject looking right, against a dark, textured background. Overlay a light-colored, flowing signature and small, clean sans-serif text in the lower right. Add a standard parental advisory label in the lower left.
